services.title: Bulk SMS
services.short: Promotional, transactional and OTP messages that reach every phone.
services.intro: Send offers, alerts and OTPs to thousands of customers in seconds, with a delivery report for every campaign.
services.seoTitle: Bulk SMS Service in Delhi, India | Promotional & OTP SMS
services.seoDesc: Bulk SMS service in India: promotional, transactional and OTP SMS with DLT support, scheduling and delivery reports. Call Data Prachar Online, New Delhi.
services.long: A good bulk SMS service is more than a gateway. Data Prachar Online helps you pick the right route for promotional, transactional or OTP messages, get your sender ID and templates registered, and send at the right time to the right city-wise audience, so your offers are read and your OTPs arrive on time.
about: Bulk SMS is one of the fastest ways to reach customers. Almost every phone can receive a text, and texts are usually seen quickly. It works for shops, schools, banks, clinics and online businesses of any size.
We help you choose the right route, set up your sender ID and message templates, and schedule each campaign. After sending, you get a delivery report so you know how many messages reached customers.
uses: Offers, sale alerts and festival greetings
points: Sender ID and message template support

faq.q: What is the difference between promotional and transactional SMS?
faq.a: Promotional SMS carries marketing offers. Transactional SMS carries service messages such as OTPs, order updates and payment alerts.

faq.q: Do I need to register anything?
faq.a: In India, businesses register their sender IDs and message templates on the telecom operators’ DLT platform before sending. We guide you through the process.

faq.q: Can I see who received the message?
faq.a: Yes. Every campaign comes with a delivery report that shows delivered and failed numbers.

services.title: Bulk Email
services.short: Newsletters and offers designed to land in the inbox.
services.intro: Professionally designed email campaigns that look right on mobile and desktop, sent in volume without the guesswork.
services.seoTitle: Bulk Email Marketing Service in India | Data Prachar Online
services.seoDesc: Bulk email marketing service: responsive templates, list cleaning, scheduled sends and open and click reports for businesses across India.
services.long: Our bulk email marketing service covers everything from design to delivery. We build mobile-friendly templates, clean and segment your list, send in controlled batches and share open and click reports, so every newsletter or offer email moves your business forward.
about: Email lets you share more than a text can: product images, prices, long offers and links. A well-built campaign keeps your brand in front of customers and sends them back to your website.
We design the template, clean and segment your list, send in batches that protect your sender reputation, and report on opens and clicks, so each campaign teaches you something for the next one.

faq.q: Will my emails reach the inbox?
faq.a: No one can promise inbox placement. We lower the risk by cleaning your list, setting up your sending domain properly and avoiding spam-trigger content.

faq.q: Can you design the email for us?
faq.a: Yes. We build mobile-friendly templates using your logo, colours and offer.

faq.q: What reports do I get?
faq.a: Sent, delivered, opened, clicked and bounced counts for every campaign.

services.title: Bulk WhatsApp
services.short: Offers, updates and reminders where your customers already chat.
services.intro: Reach customers on the app they check most, with images, PDFs and buttons in every message.
services.seoTitle: Bulk WhatsApp Marketing Service in India | Data Prachar Online
services.seoDesc: Bulk WhatsApp marketing for businesses: broadcasts with images, PDFs and buttons, template approval and reply tracking. Talk to our New Delhi team.
services.long: Our bulk WhatsApp marketing service helps you send catalogues, offers, reminders and updates with images, PDFs and buttons. We take care of template approval, broadcast scheduling and reply tracking, so your team can follow up with interested customers quickly.
about: WhatsApp is where many of your customers already talk every day. Messages with images, PDFs, videos and buttons feel personal and often get quick replies.
We set up your business number, prepare approved message templates and send broadcasts to your customer lists. Replies are tracked so your team can follow up while interest is high.
points: Message template approval handled for you

faq.q: Can I message anyone on a list?
faq.a: WhatsApp’s business policy expects you to message people who have agreed to hear from you. We set up campaigns to follow it, so your number stays safe.

faq.q: What are message templates?
faq.a: Pre-approved message formats that WhatsApp requires for chats a business starts. We prepare them and handle the approval.

faq.q: Can I send images and PDFs?
faq.a: Yes, along with videos and call-to-action buttons.

services.title: Affiliate Marketing
services.short: Pay only for the sales and sign-ups your partners deliver.
services.intro: Build a network of partners who promote your product and earn when they bring you results.
services.seoTitle: Affiliate Marketing Services in India | Pay on Results
services.seoDesc: Affiliate marketing services in India: partner recruitment, tracking links, live dashboards and fraud checks. Pay only for real sales and leads.
